messages:
Maya: Quick brainstorm  launch narrative bakeoff for next week's webinar + launch posts. We want to see which benchmark story drives higher webinar RSVPs and higher demo requests: 'Cost-per-token efficiency' vs 'end-to-end latency for product flows'.
Liam: Nice. Two hypotheses:
A) Cost story resonates with devs worried about unit economics -> higher signups but lower demo intent.
B) Latency story resonates with product/platform teams -> fewer RSVPs but more demo requests.
Carlos: Can we test copy + a small change in CTA routing? If someone clicks 'Get a demo' we route high-intent leads to SDRs; 'Try self-serve' goes to product tours.
Sam: Love it. Suggested test matrix:
- Control: baseline launch post + generic CTA
- Variant Cost: launch post highlighting $/k token + quick benchmark chart + CTA: "Slash inference costs"
- Variant Latency: launch post highlighting p50/p99 improvements + micro-benchmark gif + CTA: "Speed up your app"
Maya: We should also A/B email subject lines and one-sentence hero for landing. Examples:
- Cost subj: "Cut inference spend by up to 40% — workshop + benchmarks"
- Latency subj: "Make LLMs snappy in production — live demo"
Liam: Instrumentation needs:
- utm_experiment=bench_bakeoff, variant param on signup
- events: email_sent, rsvp, demo_requested, signup_source, lead_score
Carlos: For routing rules, keeping it simple first. Pseudocode for lead routing based on clicked CTA + lead_score:
```
if clicked_cta == 'Get a demo' or lead_score >= 70:
  route_to = 'SDR-queue'
elif clicked_cta == 'Try self-serve':
  route_to = 'Product-Onboard'
else:
  route_to = 'nurture-drip'
```
Sam: I'll mock two short social post variants (X threads) and 2 short LinkedIn intros. Maya: please prioritize a small benchmark chart for each narrative (same dataset) so it's apples-to-apples.
Maya: Also want a tiny experiment on page microcopy: metric-first vs benefit-first hero lines. Might affect clicks.
Liam: Metrics for success: primary = RSVP rate lift vs baseline; secondary = demo_request_rate and cost-per-demo. Run until 1k impressions per variant or 5 days.
Carlos: I'll add lead routing rule to leadgen webhook and tag leads with variant + source. Example payload: 
```
POST /webhook/leadgen
{ "email": "...", "variant": "latency", "cta": "Get a demo", "utm": "bench_bakeoff" }
```
leadbot: Lead routing rule created: LR-2098 (bench_bakeoff). Webhook: https://hooks.redwood/leadgen/LR-2098
Sam: Timeline: creative done by EOD tomorrow, landing + chart by Wed morning, routing + tracking in place Wed noon, flip 10% traffic Wed PM and report Fri EOD.
Maya: Owners: Liam -> copy + email; Sam -> creative + social; Carlos -> routing + tracking. I'll synthesize launch post variants and schedule a quick review at 11am tomorrow.
Liam: I'll post subject line variants in #marketing-drafts and include short A/B instructions.
Carlos: Added dashboard custom view: bench_bakeoff funnel (rsvp -> demo -> signup) and cost-per-demo calc.
Maya: Perfect. If we see large variance early we can pause and pivot. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
